name: What preparation is needed before Frasheski Construction starts a tile update?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before Frasheski Construction starts a tile update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Frasheski Construction begins a tile update, we typically recommend clearing the work area of personal items, furniture, and any fragile decorations. For kitchen or bathroom projects, it's helpful to remove items from cabinets and drawers near the work zone. We will cover and protect adjacent areas, but a clear space allows for more efficient and safe work. Our team will communicate any specific preparation requirements during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a tile update, clear the work area of personal items and furniture; our team will advise on specific preparations.
